answer: In PoA, each identity posts bonded collateral in an escrow, while signed conflicting votes establish equivocation. If k identities coordinate, correlated-equivocation penalties grow as O(k^2), so adding sybils accelerates collective liability rather than spreading risk. Detection also applies an exponential capital-loss multiplier, causing a spiral of forfeiture across the swarm. Thus, a wharf of fake validators cannot ride the tide of honest consensus.
